meeting_scene:
The team meeting was in full swing as Priya spoke up next to Sam, her words laced with a mix of concern and familiarity: "Guys, I know things have been tough lately, but we're all holding it together here." Alex jumped at this opportunity, their voice booming through the room. For once without recent thoughts, they launched into an impromptu sales pitch for our company's latest product launch on February 22nd.

Meanwhile across from them Vikram held up his hands signaling that he needed to say something and then added "I'd be grateful if we can set a clear goal at some point." Jordan interjected with his usual easy-going demeanor, reminding everyone about the team-building exercise for next week. Riya quietly asked what was expected of her in terms of progress on this project by Friday so she could prioritize accordingly.
